newsitem.title: UK: Pearson appoints new head for AWL unit.
newsitem.headline: Pearson appoints new head for AWL unit.

text.p: Peter Jovanovich will succeed J.Larry Jones as chairman and chief executive of Pearson's Addison Wesley Longman educational publishing unit from September 1, Pearson said on Monday.

Jovanovich, 48, has been president of McGraw-Hill'S Educational and Professional Publishing Group since 1995. Under his leadership the company has grown to become the largest school and college publisher in the world.
Michael Lynton, chairman and chief executive of Pearson's Penguin books arm, has been given additional responsibility to exploit Pearson's intellectual property rights across the group.
New projects include an interactive publishing venture with author Tom Clancy and his multi-media development group, Red Storm Entertainment.
